scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "AI,BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "magenta,blue,pink" "cd ai-service && if exist venv\Scripts\activate (call venv\Scripts\activate) && uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8000" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
